purpose: the last, single, unrepeated evaluation of whatever method CAM-EXP-005/006 produces

primary.what_is_held_locally: annotations and camera parameters only (1.6 GB); the ~80 GB image release has NOT been downloaded and downloading it needs an explicit decision
primary.why: genuinely static multi-camera studio rig, different from GigaHands in optics, lighting, scene and resolution, and the only candidate that can confirm BOTH the single-frame and the static-camera multi-frame claims
primary.contamination_risk: currently zero - no image has ever been read

secondary.why_limited: the released rgb/ images are per-frame hand-centred crops, so the image-space intrinsics change every frame (fx varies up to 96 % relative within one camera) and the static-camera premise does not hold; the images are also already undistorted, so the distortion-aware result cannot be confirmed on them

contamination_rules: no result from a holdout dataset may influence method choice, ensemble membership, weights, thresholds or any cue rule
no calibration model may be run on holdout images before the final experiment
structural sanity checks are allowed and must be logged

sanity_checks_performed_so_far.what: counted rgb directories and images, read image size and mode of one file, read K and M shapes from the calib json, and measured whether K is constant across frames
sanity_checks_performed_so_far.what_was_NOT_done: no calibration model was run, no image content was inspected visually, no metric was computed
sanity_checks_performed_so_far.finding: 8 cameras, 536 images, 224x224, per-frame K varies because the images are crops

sanity_checks_performed_so_far.what: read the existing preparation manifest only
sanity_checks_performed_so_far.what_was_NOT_done: no image was downloaded or read

open_decision_for_the_user: Confirming the CAM-EXP-004 static-camera result needs a second rig with genuinely static cameras and full images. Nothing local provides that. The options are (a) download the InterHand2.6M image release, (b) download the full HanCo RGB release, or (c) accept that the multi-frame claim stays single-dataset. All three were previously excluded on size grounds, so this is a decision to make rather than something to assume.
